column4: { [ -d /workspace/carla-sim/.git ] || git clone https://github.com/SAKET-23/carla-sim.git /workspace/carla-sim; } && git -C /workspace/carla-sim checkout $G1_REPO_SHA && uv pip install -e /workspace/carla-sim --no-deps && cd /workspace/carla-sim/ros2_ws && colcon build --symlink-install

{ python -c 'import torch;print(torch.__version__, torch.cuda.is_available(), torch.cuda.get_device_name(0)); x=torch.randn(1024,1024,device="cuda"); print((x@x).sum().item())' && python /workspace/carla-sim/infra/runpod/smoke/trt_check.py && python -c 'import carla, kiss_icp, onnxruntime; print(carla.__file__, kiss_icp.__version__, onnxruntime.get_device())' && source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && ros2 doctor --report | head -30; } > $G1_DIR/pins.txt 2>&1
cd /workspace/carla-sim && start_carla.sh --quality Low --town Town03 && { python -m pytest -q -m carla --junitxml=$G1_DIR/pytest_carla.xml; rc=$?; stop_carla.sh; exit $rc; }
